$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 39 (independent census). The point of this run is a corpus the author cannot see, so the criteria require BOTH tools' numbers and an explicit statement about unparsed dialects -- an empty unparsed list is a real result and must be stated, not left silent. Criterion 4 fails a file that only corroborates: it must say whether it agrees with the 92% and the 14/42/1 figures, because a result that never compares itself to the claim it was run to test is not evidence.
